english: People from the outside world\nare all weirdos.
Huh...? Um... I'm sorry.\nI-I never thought of myself that way...\nI guess I am weird...
No need to be so self-deprecating.\nI'm not blaming you.
You can use magic, but you're not a noble?\nAre you fallen nobility?
You don't look the part, though...
I think the concept of nobility is probably... different.
I see...\nCasting magic without even a wand-\nyou really are weird.
I can't cast without my wand.\nSeeing someone do it empty-handed\nmakes me feel a little awkward.
Well, I have my pride,\nso I don't plan on changing\nmy style.
Casting magic with a wand...\nI kind of admire that...
R-really?\nIt's normal to me, so\nI don't get the admiration thing...
Besides, actually...
Actually?
I'm supposed to summon a familiar\nwith Summon Servant.
But I don't have a familiar.\nWhy... just me?
Is that... unusual?
I don't know.\nI've never heard of it...
Maybe it means\nI don't need a familiar.
Anyway, right now we need to end this war.
I'll think about the familiar thing after.\nBrooding here won't give me answers.
Right.\nI... want this war to end soon too.
And for that, everyone has\nto do their best.\nGot it?
O-of course!\nUm... as much as I can...
So you do have some motivation.\nYou look so timid, I figured\nyou'd leave it all to others.
But... I'm...\nnot as strong as everyone else.
What are you saying?\nIt's about you, isn't it?\nLeaving it to others won't cut it.
Well, let's do our best.\nEven in another world,\nwe'll be fine if we support each other.
R-right.
(Is Louise anxious too...?\nShe hides it so well, it's impressive.)
Why do you irritate me so much...
I'm sorry I'm sorry I'm sorry!\nI'll fix whatever's wrong, so...
I'm not irritated\nat you.\nStop apologizing.
It's not at you, but...\nI just can't stop feeling irritated.
When I look at the others...\nsomehow... it's like...
I keep wondering what it is.
Could that be, for example... an inferiority complex?
Inferiority complex?\nWhat about me is inferior?
Me, of the Valliere family,\ninferior to commoners...?
Wha-!?\nWhere are you looking?!
What? What's wrong with my chest!?\nAre you saying it's inferior?
That's not it!\nMine's on the small side, sure,\nbut everyone else is just too big!
And I'm still growing, anyway!
Ah... um... sorry.\nI couldn't think of anything else...
Sh-sh-shut up! Idiot!\nSay another word and I'll blast you!
You don't want to anger a noble!
True... Cecilia's pretty big, for one.
That's not what we're talking about!\nCut it out!
You want to get blasted that badly?\nI'll show you the power of a bearer of the Void.
Right now I feel like I could\nmuster incredible willpower.
Thanks to you.\nI'm about to blow from anger.
I-I'm sorry!\nDon't blast me!
Never speak of it again...\nGot it?
O-okay...\nI won't... tease you\nabout your small chest...
...Are you doing that on purpose?\nYou ARE doing it on purpose!?
......... *stare*\nI won't say it again...
Sure... you're keeping your word, but\nyour eyes are saying plenty!!
...You just don't learn, do you.
Prepare yourself!!
I won't forgive you--!!
...BWAH!!
You can heal wounds?
Yes.\nWho else is here?
Um... healing wounds, right...\nY-yeah.\nA little...
So you can use Water magic...\nDot? Or Line?
Either way, being able to use\nWater magic will be useful\nas this war goes on.
But don't waste it.\nRunning out of willpower in a pinch\nwould be a problem.
Um... Dot, Line...\nWater magic...?\nI don't really follow...
You're using magic without even\nunderstanding your own element?
Unbelievable...\nOr is it some even more\nspecial power?
Recovery-type...?
There's no such element.\nThat falls under Water.
I don't... really get it...
What kind of education\ndo they give in your world?
But... right.\nIt's not just the world I know.
Then of course each world\nunderstands magic differently.
Sorry about that.\nIt's not like it's your fault.
At least in the world I know,\nhealing wounds is considered\nWater magic.
So your ability to heal probably means\nyou're good with Water magic.
H-heh...\nSo what are you good at, Louise?
M-me... the Void.
The Void.\nSo there are all kinds of elements...
No.\nEven in my world, very few people\ncan use the Void.
As far as we know right now...\nthree.
That's it.
It's a special power, then.
That's why it takes so much willpower,\nand the incantations take so long.
While I'm casting, I'm defenseless,\nso enemy attacks hit me easily.
...Then if you get hurt, Louise,\nI'll heal you.
Sorry...\nIt's not much, but I wanted to help if I can...
...You.\nTh-that's obvious!\nThat's why you're here with us, isn't it!
That was the plan from the start.
...So you be careful too.\nDon't get hurt.
...Louise.
If you get hurt,\nthat's one less person to heal wounds!\nDon't get the wrong idea!
Ugh, enough!\nJust focus on recovering\nyour own willpower.
Don't come crying to me if you get\ntired in the middle of battle!
...I'm sorry.\nIf I'm wrong... um...
What? Spit it out.
Um... are you in a bad mood?
Do I look like it?
N-no... must be my imagination.
Right. Don't worry about it.
...Okay...
...People call you dense, don't they.
If you don't realize it,\nthen you're dense, so remember that.
You back down right away.\nYou should learn to pay\nmore attention.
Otherwise you're disqualified as a noble?
But... I'm not a noble.
I know that.
And that other worlds have\nfew people called nobles.\nI understand that by now.
But bearing matters, doesn't it?\nA noble's grace seeps out\nfrom exactly those things.
If you can't even escort a lady,\nyou're hopeless in any world.
Hmm... fine.\nThen I'll teach you how a noble behaves.
Can I even do it...?
It won't be easy.\nIt might be impossible.
Huh? N-no, it's fine.\nI can't trouble you like that...
I'm saying I'll oversee it myself.\nNormally I'd never do\nsomething like that for anyone.
Just do as you're told\nand fix your behavior.
It's for my sake too.\nI can't travel with someone\nwho'd shame the Valliere name, can I?
This is why commoners... wait,\ncan I even call you a commoner?
'Commoner' bugs me, but...\nif I'm not a noble, then probably...
Listen. Even a commoner has to\nfix their manners at least.
That's the bare minimum of courtesy\nfor speaking with a noble.
I see...
Ugh! Stop giving me half-hearted answers!
Ow!?\nHuh? Where'd you get that...?\nIsn't that a riding crop!?
That doesn't matter!\nAct up and I'll smack you!
It's not like I enjoy hitting you, okay?
This is education!\nWhen you mess up...
Eep!?
No mercy.\nHee hee hee.
...Louise?\nYou look like you're enjoying this...
N-no, I'm not!\nI don't want to do this either!
But it can't be helped, can it?\nA noble like me has to educate you.
Is there any other noble here?
But... I'm... not a noble...
Now! Let's begin!\nFirst I'll fix that denseness of yours.
An attentive man makes\na good impression.
First of all, pay attention to me.\nOnce you can do that,\nyou can pay attention to lots of people.
Before you know it, you'll be\ncloser to noble behavior.
Hah...\nSo, what are you holding?\nYou're cradling it like it's precious.
...This?\nI don't know what this is,\nbut I can't bring myself to ask anyone else...
It was really cold at first,\nbut now it's a little lukewarm.
...A can of juice...?\nIt's gone warm over time.
Huh, so it's called a can of juice...\nSo... what is it?
You were in a bad mood...\n...over something like that?
What do you mean, 'something like that'!!
Owww!?
Didn't anyone teach you that words\nthat upset people are bad?
I'll teach you how to use words, starting now!
Now... show me.
...Y-yes.\nThe bow, taking your hand, like this... how's that?
...No grace.\nI feel no noble grace from it.
Well... I'm not a noble...
I don't like that attitude.\nManners aren't just for nobles.\nRight?
If you understand, then\nmaster it properly.
That said...\nhow do I draw out your grace?\nTricky.
Your appearance... can't be helped, I guess.\nIt's your mindset.
Maybe I need to fix that mindset of yours\nfrom the root-always limiting yourself.
Otherwise you'll just make excuses again\nabout not being a noble.
Excuses...?\nIt's technically true, though...
If I'm beating it out of you from the root,\nI'll have to get more serious too.
Eep!
I've been gentle until now, right?\nI'll be a little stricter.
I'm sure part of the problem is\nthat I've been spoiling you.
Don't worry!\nBy the time we're done, you'll be a gentleman.
Huh?\nWas that the goal?
It's a matter of manners.\nSame thing.
From now on, even when I hit you,\ndon't give up right away.
Got it?
I'm about to give up already...
I won't allow that.\nI don't plan on quitting halfway either.
I'll do my best.\n...As much as I can.
For now... that'll do.\nAs long as you're motivated.
From now on, I'm going strict!
...Yes.
Sit there.
Um... sorry.\nBut why am I getting scolded?
You claim you did nothing?\nThen I'll remind you!
You, today...\nT-T-T-Tiffa's... th-th-th...
You were looking at Tiffa's... weren't you...?
Huh? Um...\nI didn't catch that...
Grr!\nYou were staring at Tiffa's chest!!
I know exactly what you're doing!\nYou think nobody notices you staring,\nbut it's obvious!
Confess!\nThat mindset needs fixing\nbefore any noble behavior.
N-no, you've got it wrong.\nThough I can't say it never enters my field of vision.
See! You ARE looking!
Tiffania looked troubled, so\nI thought I'd... help if I could.
You think some plausible excuse\nlike that will get you off the hook?
Men are all the same.\nYou all like them big.
Disgusting!\nI bet you were looking at Siesta's too, weren't you?
N-no, that's wrong...\nYou told me to pay attention to the people around me...
Me first!\nYou can't pay attention to others\nif you can't pay attention to me!
So no staring at other girls'\nchests. Understood?
Do it again and\nI'll whip you.
You won't learn without education,\nso it can't be helped, right?
I'm not staring...
Then you're saying you're NOT looking!?\nReally?
Well... if something catches my eye, I look...\nif it doesn't, I never look.\nI can... swear to that...
So mine never\ncatches your eye.\nYou've never once looked at mine.
You're only interested in big ones!\nIdiooot!!
I'm sorry... I probably do look...\nMy eyes just wander sometimes...
See, I knew it.\nReflect on that...\n...wait, where are YOU looking?!
Y-you don't have to look at mine either!!\nSo size doesn't matter to you!?\nYou're so shameless!
Anyway, next time there'll be no mercy.\nRemember that.
Y-yes...\nI'll be careful...
Lately, everything surprises me.
Surprises you...?
Worlds completely different from\nTristain or Halkeginia...\nI never imagined they existed.
Everyone here came from\ndifferent worlds, right?
So many other worlds...\nI couldn't have imagined it.
I think everyone feels the same...
People who use powers other than magic,\nordinary commoners who can fight.
People like that exist.\nWas my worldview too narrow?
Even so, I'm a noble, so\nI can't afford to lose my composure.
If this got out in Tristain,\nthey'd start researching it.
If that happened... what would become of it?
Well.\nMaybe everyone could learn\nto travel between worlds.
But it won't be that easy.\nIf it were, someone\nwould've done it long ago.
It could cause serious problems\nwith the balance of power.
That... would be bad.
Hee. Well, it's pointless\nto dwell on, anyway.
I'm just genuinely surprised.\nIt feels so fresh.
But I'm anxious too.\nMy magic might not\nwork at all.
The Void is rare even in my world,\nbut if there's a world where\nthat Void magic doesn't work...
Louise...
Thinking about it scares me a little.\nAmong so many worlds,\nyou can't say there's none, right?
The reverse is possible too...\nA world where magic works too well.\nThat probably exists as well.
That's scary too.\nBecause then I'd probably\nbe feared.
Then...\nwill you be on my side?
Of course!\nNot just me... everyone's on your side.
...R-really?\nThis is embarrassing... this kind of thing.
S-so... thank you.
Depending on the time and place...\nProbably... on your side.
How unreliable.\nCan't you say something smoother?
I'm expecting a little from you,\nso live up to it.
This is a request from me, you know?\nBe honored.
(She's relying on me...\nI never thought she'd say something like that to me...)
...Hey.
Hey, wake up.
Louise...?\nIt's kind of bright...
Finally awake?\nHonestly.
Louise...\nwhat's with that outfit...?
Nice, right?\nOr would you prefer my usual outfit?
Never mind that-\nhow long are you going to sleep in the hallway?\nWe're going to the classroom.
...Huh?
Here, the menu.
Um... what was this place again?\nMy head's all fuzzy...
It's a cafe, duh! Don't you remember?
Honestly, get it together.
That's why you keep wandering around aimlessly.
I told you, didn't I?\nLearn to pay attention to me.
...Pay attention... oh, right!\nLouise, that outfit suits you.
...Too slow. Idiot.
Today's your reward for working hard.\nBe grateful.
A reward...!?
It's a noble's duty to honor a retainer's loyalty.
That's why I'm dressed as a waitress today.
See the display case over there?\nThere's cake, right?
It's for you to eat. I prepared it for you.
Eat it gratefully.\nIf you want tea, I have that ready too.
Thank... you.\nI'm really happy.
It's store-bought, but that's fine, right?
It's not like I bought it just for you!
I got it along with everyone else's, that's all! Don't get the wrong idea!
Y-yes... I'm happy even if it's just along the way...
...Oh. But you're first.
I permit you to eat first.
So... um...\nfrom now on... okay... with me...
Huh? What?
Wake up!
...Hm? Huh?\nWhere's the cake?
Cake? What are you talking about?\nAre you still half asleep?
Stop spacing out.
Louise... you were a waitress...
...Calling me, a noble, a waitress?\n...Huh, you've got guts!
So in your dream, I was\nserving you as a waitress...
Get yourself together!\nI'm beating that attitude out of you after all.
N-no, come on.\nIt was just a dream...!?
No arguments--!!
Nooo--!?\nOwowowow!?
